exclusions.source_text: CrCl or GFR ≥30 mL/min as estimated by the Cockcroft-Gault equation, the CKD-EPI equation, or as measured by 24-hour urine collection
total bilirubin ≤2 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN), or ≤3 x institutional ULN if due to Gilbert's syndrome, or with PI approval if clearly due to disease under study
For females of childbearing potential, a serum pregnancy test must be negative within screening period.
Other diagnosis of active malignancy or systemic therapy within 2 years of study treatment.
Known central nervous system involvement with CLL or SLL.
Congestive heart failure, New York Heart Association III/IV.
myocardial infarction within 6 months before screening.
Heart rate-corrected QT interval \> 480 milliseconds based on Fridericia's formula corrected for bundle branch block as appropriate.
History of HIV infection or active hepatitis B (chronic or acute) or hepatitis C infection.
Pregnant women are excluded from this study given potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.
breastfeeding should be discontinued prior to the first dose of study drug if the mother is treated.
Known CNS hemorrhage or stroke within 6 months of the study.
